Does shipping Magic Keyboard support auto-translate my China listing?

No. UIKeyCommand handlers and trackpad gesture support are in-app features — they do not fill App Store Connect localization rows. If zh-Hans fields are empty, the China product page falls back to en-US copy.

How is this different from Apple Pencil listing copy?

Apple Pencil marketing covers stylus hardware — handwriting, sketching, drawing, Hover — 手写, 标注. Magic Keyboard marketing covers the folio keyboard-and-trackpad cover for iPad — typing, iPadOS shortcuts, trackpad cursor — 妙控键盘, Magic Keyboard for iPad, 键盘快捷键. No. This page covers Apple Magic Keyboard for iPad — the folio keyboard-and-trackpad accessory buyers attach to iPad. It is not QuickType tap typing, not swipe typing, and not the software keyboard UI that appears on screen when users tap text fields without an external keyboard.

Full Keyboard Access covers system Accessibility navigation with Tab and arrow keys — 完整键盘访问, 焦点环. Magic Keyboard covers Apple's iPad keyboard-and-trackpad accessory and shortcut workflows — 妙控键盘, 妙控键盘触控板. Accessory marketing, not Accessibility settings copy.

Stage Manager and Split View cover iPad multitasking windowing — 台前调度, 分屏, 侧拉. This page covers Magic Keyboard hardware productivity — typing, shortcuts, and trackpad navigation — not resize handles or window shelves.

No. Magic Keyboard for iPad is a combined keyboard and trackpad cover. This page treats keyboard and trackpad as one Apple accessory product — we do not maintain a separate trackpad-only listing page.
